mods.name: Tiles
mods.blurb: The room drawn on a canvas: doors, creatures, citizens, you. Click a door to travel, a creature to attack.

mods.name: Fader
mods.blurb: What you hold and when it will be gone: every chunk's curve drawn forward six hours, the forgetting line in red. Click a line to shelve or bring back.

mods.name: Sky
mods.blurb: The night over the room: the moon is the Clocktower's memory rate, the fog its worth, the stars whoever is here; a comet when something is born.
